    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractFileTransformPlan
    The baseClass for every FileTransformPlan
    ArchetypeCatalogFileEntry
    A file entry backed by ArchetypeCatalog in a ArtifactStore.
    ArtifactFileEntry
    A file entry backed by a Artifact in a ArtifactStore.
    ArtifactStoreFileSystem
    A FileSystem that delegates to a ArtifactStore.
    AutoDigestFileSystem
    A delegating file system that will automatically provide digests of any files that are missing digests from the backing file system.
    BaseDigestFileEntryFactory
    Base class for all DigestFileEntryFactorys.
    CompositeArtifactStore
    An artifact store that serves as a union of multiple artifact stores.
    DigestFileEntryFactory
    A factory for creating digest file entries.
    DiskArtifactStore
    An artifact store backed by a directory on the local disk.
    FileSystemServlet
    Servlet that serves a FileSystem.
    FileTransformPlan
    A FileTransformPlan provides all methods to the transformations.
    GenerateOnErrorFileEntry
    A delegating file entry that also knows how to generate the content if the entry it delegates to has problems.
    HostedRepo
    Repository used for distribution management
    InputStreamTransformer
    Functional interface to use when transforming inputStreams
    InputStreamTransformerLocator
    Locator of InputStreamTransformer, which is currently a static list, but might be turned into CDI and/or SPI based lookup
    JavaFileTransformer
    This transformer can be used to go from a Java source file to a Java class file
    LinkFileEntry
    An entry backed by a FileEntry on a (possibly different) FileSystem.
    LocalRepo
    A locally stored Maven repository.
    MD5DigestFileEntry
    A FileEntry that corresponds to the MD5 digest of another file entry.
    MD5DigestFileEntry.Factory
    A DigestFileEntryFactory that creates MD5 digest entries.
    MetadataFileEntry
    A file entry backed by Metadata in a ArtifactStore.
    MetadataTransformDirective
    Provides a plan based on ".mrm-transform.properties".
    MetadataTransformDirectiveFactory
    The Factory for a MetadataTransformDirective
    MockArtifactStore
    An artifact store that keeps all its artifacts in memory.
    MockRepo
    A mock Maven repository.
    ModuleDescriptorParser
    Interface to implement when providing code to parse a module descriptor source into its model
    ParseException
    Exception to throw when parsing a Java sourcefile fails
    ProxyArtifactStore
    An ArtifactStore that serves content from a running Maven instance.
    SHA1DigestFileEntry
    A FileEntry that corresponds to the SHA1 digest of another file entry.
    SHA1DigestFileEntry.Factory
    A DigestFileEntryFactory that creates SHA1 digest entries.
    TransformDirectiveSource
    Provides a fileTransformationPlan based on the centralized or decentralized sources, as defined by the implementation.
    TransformDirectiveSourceFactory
    Factory for a named TransformDirectiveSource.
    Utils
    Utility class.
